description: pvcaptest is a Python package for analysing photovoltaic capacity tests under ASTM E2848. It loads, filters and regresses measured plant data, then reports capacity-test summaries through a documented CapData class. Users supply production and environmental measurements from a PV system; outputs include fitted performance relationships and capacity-test results for that plant. Geographic coverage follows the monitored site. The README links examples and documentation, and GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that the quality of a capacity result depends on sensor calibration, filtering criteria and compliance with the test procedure; this metadata review did not check implementation against the ASTM standard. The tool can validate solar-generation assumptions before they are used in electricity-system simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 record supplies regional weather reanalysis, not plant acceptance measurements. No site data or package was downloaded.
name: pvcaptest PV capacity-test analysis
